description: Prepare an existing public website for migration into Panderr. Returns a Panderr link where the user can begin the migration and open the resulting website project for editing.

mode.description: Migration approach. Preserve keeps the existing website presentation as faithfully as possible. Improve preserves the source as an editable baseline for deliberate improvements. Panderr Redesign creates a new design direction using the existing website content, business information, and assets as its source.
